title: Farmington, NM — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Farmington, NM: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Farmington is a city in NM with a population of 45,000. Four Corners region hub with the Bisti Badlands and a strong energy industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 275 sunny days a year.
